Date: 2026-02-22 11:00
Subject: Warehouse handling concern for item identifiers

Hi All,

During the warehouse pilot, the team raised a usability concern around how item identifiers are handled on labels and during scanning.

In daily operations, staff tend to refer to the machine-readable identifier as the barcode or serial code rather than by the formal term used in the specification. The current business-oriented format may be less convenient for the scanning workflow than a more scanner-friendly representation.

For now, please review whether the warehouse-facing identifier should remain just an operational alias in the UI, or whether a separate machine-readable identifier is needed alongside the formal item identifier. The main goal is to reduce ambiguity for staff and avoid slowing down intake and return handling.

Thanks,
Gary (Logistics)

## 8. Delivery Management

## 8.1 Delivery Options
## 8.1.1 The system shall allow users to choose a delivery method for a rent, including pickup and delivery.
## 8.1.2 The system shall require the user to provide a delivery address when delivery is selected.
## 8.1.3 The system shall validate the delivery address before confirming the rent.

## 8.2 Delivery Scheduling
## 8.2.1 The system shall allow users to select a delivery time window.
## 8.2.2 The system shall validate that the selected delivery time window is available.
## 8.2.3 The system shall prevent scheduling delivery outside supported delivery hours.

## 8.3 Delivery Lifecycle
## 8.3.1 The system shall create a delivery record associated with the rent record when delivery is selected.
## 8.3.2 The system shall support delivery status values including Scheduled, In Transit, Delivered, and Failed.
